critical_code_review_comments: QuickCommunicationPanel.js: the fix is correct and minimal. Deps for defaultNumber/defaultEmail are primitive fields; interpolation useEffect depends only on primitive client fields + templateKey/channel/templates; prefill useEffect fires only when dialogOpen transitions to true. This is the canonical React pattern for isolating a controlled input from parent-driven re-renders.

QuickCommunicationPanel.js L156-160: the prefill useEffect depends on [dialogOpen, defaultNumber, defaultEmail]. Because defaultNumber/defaultEmail are memoised on primitive deps, changing them mid-open (e.g. if parent updates client.finance_mobile while dialog is open) will still overwrite the user's edit. This edge case is exceedingly rare (would require the client contact to be edited by another user during the dialog's lifetime) and probably intentional. If ever a bug, gate the prefill on `if (!dialogOpen) return;` AND on a ref that tracks 'was previously closed'.

TasksToday.js/TasksEffectiveness.js/Regularizations.js: already follow the correct pattern (useCallback + fetcher in deps of useEffect). No changes needed. AuthContext.js exposes getAuthHeaders via useCallback, making it stable and safe as a hook dep.
Double initial fetch on all 3 list pages (2 calls instead of 1) is React 18 StrictMode dev-only double invocation and NOT a bug. In production build, only 1 call would fire.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent E1 in iter45): the previous QuickCommunicationPanel had a useEffect that (a) recomputed defaultNumber/defaultEmail whenever the entire `client` object identity changed (new reference on every parent fetch), and (b) inside a separate useEffect, reset setPhoneNumber(defaultNumber) & setEmailTo(defaultEmail) unconditionally on those recomputed values. Every time the parent's fetchData() completed (~ every 5-10s in the client detail screen, or on any child-triggered re-fetch), the client object reference changed → defaultNumber recomputed to the same string but with new identity via useMemo which itself depended on `client` → the reset useEffect fired → user's in-progress edit was wiped. Fix: (1) defaultNumber/defaultEmail now depend on primitive fields (finance_mobile, mobile, phone / finance_email, email) so identity is stable when values are stable; (2) the reset useEffect now depends on [dialogOpen, defaultNumber, defaultEmail] but only takes action when `if (!dialogOpen) return;` guards the initial mount path — since defaults are stable and dialogOpen only flips true→false→true, the effect body only meaningfully runs on the true transition. Verified in browser: after typing '999999999' into the phone input and waiting 6 seconds plus a template change, the value remained '999999999'. On dialog close+reopen, the default '351912345678' correctly reappeared, confirming the reset-on-open behaviour is preserved.
